faqItems.q: How soon can we start an in-house training?
faqItems.a: Plan two to three weeks between the first call and the session, enough time to align the program on your cases and to handle logistics.

faqItems.q: Are remote sessions just as good?
faqItems.a: Yes. The remote format is built to stay hands-on: live workshops, screen sharing, breakout exercises, and access to the post-session prompt library.

faqItems.q: Can you adapt the content to our industry?
faqItems.a: Always. Before the session we discuss your priority use cases and we build the exercises from your real material.
We can review the funding with your OPCO and, if needed, route the agreement through a Qualiopi partner. The detail depends on your industry.
Six to twelve for Discovery and Practice. Four to eight for Agents & automation, where we keep close support.

agents.metaDescription: Three AI agents for demanding brands. Hermes prospects, Achilles produces, Hestia tends. Turnkey setup, human supervision, clean exit.
agents.heroSubtitle: Hermes opens. Achilles conquers. Hestia tends. Three figures of antiquity at the service of your brand. One agent to win customers, one to produce without pause, one to tend your hearth.
agents.introBody: TROIE agents take the repetitive, measurable and time-eating workloads. They prospect, write, reply. Always in your brand voice. Always under human supervision. Always reversible: at the end of the contract, you keep the workflows and the prompts.
agents.packPriceQuoteHint: Setup and subscription calibrated on your volume, stack and quality bar. Pricing shared after the 30-minute free audit.

methodSteps.title: 01 · Audit
methodSteps.body: 30 minutes on the phone to understand your volumes, your tools, your voice. No strings attached.

methodSteps.title: 02 · Brief & setup
methodSteps.body: We write your brand brief, wire your tools, calibrate the agent. Two to four weeks depending on the agent.

methodSteps.title: 03 · Go-live
methodSteps.body: The agent ships. TROIE human supervision for 30 days. Daily tuning.

methodSteps.title: 04 · Autonomy
methodSteps.body: You keep the keys, the workflow, the prompts. TROIE stays on subscription support, never lock-in.

agents.customTitle: An agent that isn't on the list?
agents.customBody: Application screening, financial ops, community moderation, market intelligence, multimodal agent on your patents: we design and ship made-to-order, same grammar, brief, workflow, supervision, clean exit.
agents.auditBandTitle: Thirty minutes to tell you if an agent pays off in your shop.
agents.auditBandSubtitle: Free audit. No strings. A clear, numbered, written answer. Even if the answer is no.

faqItems.q: Does my data leave the European Union?
faqItems.a: Not by default. All agents run on EU-hosted models (Mistral, Claude via European region) or via gateways with contractual guarantees. A fully sovereign variant is available on request.

faqItems.q: What happens at the end of the contract?
faqItems.a: You keep your Make / n8n workflows, your prompt library, your accesses. No lock-in. No proprietary SaaS to abandon. You can carry on alone or with another partner.

faqItems.q: How long before it actually helps?
faqItems.a: Hermes: 30 days for the first qualified meetings. Achilles: 14 days for the first publishable contents. Hestia: 21 days to push 60 % of tickets into autonomous mode.

faqItems.q: Can an agent replace my team?
faqItems.a: No. An agent absorbs the repetitive, measurable load. It frees your team for what needs judgment, relationship, creation. On TROIE's side, it stays boutique, always.

faqItems.q: What if the agent says something off-brand to a customer?
faqItems.a: Hestia runs strict guardrails: allowed topics, escalation topics, fenced brand voice. During the first 4 weeks, a TROIE human validates edge cases before send. Beyond that, error rate is tracked continuously.

agents.finalCtaSubtitle: Pick your agent, or start with a free 30-minute audit. The answer will be clear either way.
